values./description: Encounters at terrain that is difficult to bypass.
values./results/@92564bf5a7f53485/description: Three raiders demand 50 caps × the highest-level raider. Opposed CHA + Barter or Speech can reduce it to 40 caps × level; refusal causes hostility.
values./results/@1fec46ae758b39d6/description: A military robot, often a Mister Gutsy, has strict orders to block passage and attacks anyone passing without a reason its programming accepts.
values./results/@7e138411649ea49c/description: Three raiders shake down two farmers. Saving them earns 2d20 caps, but approaching PCs may provoke hostility.
values./results/@7e76bd172daf1945/description: Settlement guards allow passage only to travellers who holster weapons and show no ill intent.
values./results/@aa0d91405585f115/description: There are 3+3 CD fragmentation mines and no easy route around. Each requires difficulty 2 PER + Explosives; failure detonates it, and each Effect on explosive damage triggers another mine.
